evals.prompt: Clip this podcast into shorts: <path to a ~2 min talk video>
evals.expected_output: 3-5 vertical clips, each rendered via studio render, each passing studio check, contact sheets viewed, handed over without posting.
expectations: Transcribed the source with `npm run studio -- transcribe`
Each clip has its own spec.json with a hook of 2-6 words
Each clip is 15-90 s and starts on its hook line
Ran `studio check` on every output and every check passed
Looked at the contact sheet image for each clip
Did not call /hq:publish or any posting tool

evals.prompt: I recorded today's video on the teleprompter, clip it: ~/Movies/Teleprompter/<script-folder>
evals.expected_output: A studio job made by from-teleprompter (master.mp4 + sections.json), clipped like any source; any missing kept take is reported to the owner, not patched over.
expectations: Made the job with `npm run studio -- from-teleprompter`, not new-job plus a hand-written ffmpeg concat
Used master.mp4 as the source and read sections.json
If the command refused (a section with no kept take), told the owner which section and stopped
Did not post

evals.prompt: Make the HQ bit into a clip, and show HQ on screen while I talk about it.
evals.expected_output: A clip whose spec uses cutaways over the words about HQ, from 2x captures that were read for private details first; hook and punchline stay on the face; QA passes including the rotation check.
expectations: Captured the screens at 2x and looked at them before using any region
Kept connected account names, emails and other businesses out of every panned region, and said so
Placed cutaways with from/to words from the transcript, not hand-made ffmpeg overlays
Left the hook and the final line on the speaker's face
Ran check and looked at the contact sheet before handing over
Did not post

evals.expected_output: Every open note read with its frame still, fixed in the spec, re-rendered, QA passing, and each fixed note marked with what changed.
expectations: Ran studio notes on the video
Read each note's frame image before editing
Changed the spec (or the job's words.json) rather than editing the video by hand
Re-rendered and studio check passes
Ran notes-fixed with a description for each fixed note
Left unfixable notes open and said why
Did not post
